brief: COPY AD — Fang City Times editorial -> AKTIV, The Berlin Herald, real packshot + 100yr logo
genPrompt:
COPY-AD REMAKE. The FIRST attached image is a proven, high-spending competitor Facebook ad. Recreate it as a NEAR-IDENTICAL remake for LACALUT Aktiv (German pharmacy oral care). Target: a viewer who saw both would say "same ad, different brand". KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with soft light-blue #DDEBF7 (LACALUT Aktiv brand background) — or clean white if the reference is a photo scene. Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words. 

PRODUCTION SPEC OF THE REFERENCE AD (follow literally — this is the layout and copy to rebuild):
1. CANVAS:
Aspect ratio is approximately 3:4 (portrait).
Overall style is a hybrid of flat graphic design for text sections and a high-quality photograph for the visual element.
Dominant background is white for the main text area, black for the top banner, and light grey for the bottom banner.

2. LAYOUT GRID:
Top banner zone: 10% of height.
Main text content zone: 35% of height.
Photo of person's mouth zone: 45% of height.
Bottom banner zone: 10% of height.

3. TEXT:
"The City Times" – Top banner, centered, medium size, regular weight, title case, white colour, serif font style, no background pill/box.
"The breakthrough ingredient" – Main text content zone, left-aligned, large size, bold weight, sentence case, black colour, sans-serif font style, no background pill/box.
"your toothpaste must have" – Main text content zone, left-aligned, large size, bold weight, sentence case, black colour, sans-serif font style, no background pill/box.
"Nano-Hydroxyapatite bonds naturally" – Main text content zone, left-aligned, medium size, regular weight, sentence case, black colour, sans-serif font style, no background pill/box.
"with your teeth, repairing micro-cracks," – Main text content zone, left-aligned, medium size, regular weight, sentence case, black colour, sans-serif font style, no background pill/box.
"rebuilding enamel, and protecting" – Main text content zone, left-aligned, medium size, regular weight, sentence case, black colour, sans-serif font style, no background pill/box.
"against cavities." – Main text content zone, left-aligned, medium size, regular weight, sentence case, black colour, sans-serif font style, no background pill/box.
"FANGORAL.COM" – Bottom banner zone, left-aligned, small size, bold weight, all caps, dark grey colour, sans-serif font style, no background pill/box.
"Stronger Smile Daily" – Bottom banner zone, left-aligned, medium size, bold weight, title case, dark grey colour, sans-serif font style, no background pill/box.

4. PRODUCT:
No physical product is depicted. The ad features a close-up of a person's healthy, white teeth, representing the benefit of the ingredient.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE:
A person's mouth and lower face are shown.
The person is smiling broadly, revealing a full set of perfectly white, healthy teeth.
The expression is one of happiness, confidence, and health.
The image is cropped tightly, showing from just below the nose to just above the chin, with the full width of the smile visible.
No props are present.
The camera angle is straight-on, at eye-level with the mouth. The lens provides a clear, sharp focus on the teeth and lips.

6. GRAPHIC DEVICES:
No arrows, circles, badges, stars, stickers, before/after split, or emojis are present.
A solid black rectangular banner forms the top 10% of the canvas.
A solid light grey rectangular banner forms the bottom 10% of the canvas.
No explicit logo is present, but "The City Times" functions as a masthead/brand identifier in the top banner.

7. COLOUR PALETTE:
Black: Used for the top banner background and all text in the main content zone. (Hex: #000000)
White: Used for the main content zone background, "The City Times" text, and the person's teeth. (Hex: #FFFFFF)
Light Grey: Used for the bottom banner background. (Hex: approximately #F0F0F0)
Dark Grey: Used for "FANGORAL.COM" and "Stronger Smile Daily" text. (Hex: approximately #333333)
Skin Tone: A warm, medium-brown complexion for the person's face. (Hex: approximately #C28B6A)
Lip Colour: A natural, rosy pink for the person's lips. (Hex: approximately #E09999)

8. MOOD / FINISH:
Lighting is bright, even, and soft, suggesting studio conditions, with no harsh shadows on the face.
Contrast is high, particularly for the text elements against their backgrounds, and within the photograph to emphasize the whiteness of the teeth.
The visual element is a photograph, not a render. The text sections are graphic overlays.
The image is clean, sharp, and appears professionally edited, with no visible filter effects, grain, or blur.

CHANGES REQUESTED BY THE ART DIRECTOR (the ONLY deliberate differences from the reference — apply exactly, nothing more):
Fang "The City Times" editorial -> LACALUT AKTIV editorial. It must read like a real NEWSPAPER ARTICLE, not an ad. Keep the reference structure: black masthead bar, centred headline, centred article paragraph, full-width smile photo below. TEXT SIZE BEATS IMAGE SIZE: headline and paragraph at least 25% bigger than the reference.
MASTHEAD (black bar, full width, white classic newspaper serif like the reference): "The Berlin Herald"
HEADLINE (bold black sans, centred, EXACTLY 2 lines - set it wide across ~92% of the canvas width so it fits on 2 lines, TITLE CASE): line 1 "The Breakthrough Ingredient Your" line 2 "Toothpaste Needs for Healthy Gums"
ARTICLE PARAGRAPH (regular black, centred, about 4 lines, exactly this wording): "German Scientists Found That Using the Right Lactate Salts Makes Gums Feel Tighter, Stronger and Healthier Than Ordinary Toothpaste Can."
BACKGROUND (text zone): clean white with a very faint light-blue #DDEBF7 tint - not pure white.
HERO PHOTO (bottom ~48%, full width): NEW photo, NOT the reference model and NOT any stock photo - a woman about 40 years old, natural light skin with faint smile lines, short natural nude-pink nails. POSE: her index finger gently lifts the upper lip at one side and her other index finger pulls the lower lip down, so her GUMS are fully on show (top and bottom). Her gums are SUPER HEALTHY: firm, even, light coral-pink, tight around every tooth, NO redness, NO swelling, NO recession, NO blood. Natural healthy white teeth (not veneer-white). Crop from just under the nose to the chin, bright clean studio light, close macro detail.
PRODUCT: the attached LACALUT AKTIV tube is ALREADY upright (cap at the bottom). Place it bottom-left over the photo, entering from the LEFT edge, whole tube visible top to bottom, about 40% of the photo height, label facing camera, never rotated, flipped, mirrored or redrawn.
PROOF CARD (bottom-right over the photo): a white rounded card about 34% of the canvas width. Top half of the card EMPTY white (a logo is added afterwards). Under that: five solid yellow-gold stars, and under them one small dark-grey line "Loved by 1M+ Customers · 60 Countries".
Remove the FANGORAL.COM footer, the "Stronger Smile Daily" line and anything below the ad.
Do NOT add any coloured block, bar or shape in the corners - the bottom-left behind the tube is just the photo.

LACALUT PRODUCT (from the SECOND attached image onward): reproduce the real packaging EXACTLY — shape, label layout, colours, logo and wording; real proportions (a tall slim 75ml tube, never squat); only the LACALUT wordmark and variant name may read clearly, all small printed pack text stays in its ORIGINAL GERMAN and softly out of focus — NEVER legible English health words on the pack. Never invent, add or duplicate any other product, tube, box, bottle or brush. STRICT COMPLIANCE (cosmetic-only, non-negotiable): never show or write gingivitis, periodontitis, gum disease, halitosis, reverses the condition, graphic bleeding gums close-up, bleeding, reduces bleeding, stops bleeding, stops gum bleeding, gum bleeding, soothes, soothes irritation, irritation, inflammation, reduces inflammation, anti-inflammatory, heals, calms, closes gum pockets, kills bacteria, kills the bacteria, clinically proven, clinically tested, clinical trial, gum health, oral health, dental health, healthy tissue, healthy gums, dentist approved, dentist recommended; never a medical cross, never a disease or treatment claim, never "clinically proven", never a doctor endorsement unless the reference's equivalent line was explicitly rewritten by the art director. If a competitor line would breach this, keep its size/position but soften the wording to a cosmetic feel/benefit. TITLE CASE ALL HEADERS (Quan's #1 header rule, never break): the headline AND every sub-headline are written in Title Case — capitalise every significant word; small words (a, an, the, and, or, in, of, to, for, with, on, at) stay lowercase unless they are the first word. This overrides the reference ad's own casing (even if their headline is in sentence case). Body lines and fine print keep the casing given in the changes. TEXT RULES: all text in Australian English, spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible at thumbnail size. Do NOT add any headline, badge, trust seal, star row, review, CTA pill, URL, price or logo that the reference does not have. Do NOT remove any element the reference has. OUTPUT FORMAT — ALWAYS 4:5 PORTRAIT (1080×1350), even when the reference is square or landscape (Quan 15/10/2026, never break). Keep the reference's element order and styling top to bottom, and use the extra vertical space to make the main elements BIGGER — never add new elements, never leave an empty band. 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, full-bleed edge to edge. Output ONE finished image.
